source_review: The original TestRenameWithSnapshots#testRenameUndo_1 starts MiniDFSCluster, creates two directories and a snapshot, then explicitly calls root.replaceChild(dir2, mockDir2, inodeMap) before the rename-rollback operation. That call makes the selected check reachable on the healthy path; the first disjunct should be true because dir2 is the current root child. Exact runtime guard and failure instrumentation, observed pre-target I/O, and fault trials remain pending.
